verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk data export, backup, or account-exit feature in open formats such as CSV, JSON, or XML. Saving individual invoices as PDF is a per-document delivery feature, not a full data export. The API that mirrors web-client operations is a developer building block a user could use to build their own export, not a first-party export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
